hero.title: Say what you need.
hero.description: Need & Know connects the real problems NGOs and communities are stuck on with the research and expertise that could help, explains why each connection makes sense, and puts a person between the suggestion and the introduction.
hero.caption: Starting in Suisse romande, on climate adaptation.

problem.title: The knowledge exists. It just doesn’t reach the people who need it.
problem.intro: Researchers publish findings that could change how a project is run. NGOs on the ground face problems that someone, somewhere, has already studied. Most of the time, neither finds the other.
cards: Platforms record what organisations are doing: projects launched, pledges made. Almost none record what they’re stuck on. You can’t match a need nobody has written down.
Research moves too slowly to help.
By the time findings are published, the project that needed them may have ended. Practitioners need a route to relevant knowledge while it can still make a difference.
Projects end, websites go stale, lessons-learned reports are never made public. The next team starts from zero, often in the next village.
problem.closing: Search engines and registries tell you who exists. They don’t tell you who can help with this, here, now.

idea.title:
Start with the need.
Make the connection.
idea.intro: A registry records who has declared something. Need & Know records who needs something.
idea.body: We’re building around the need: a problem, in the words of the people holding it, with what would help, where it’s happening, and by when it matters. A match needs two sides. We bring them together.

steps: An NGO, municipality or community group says what it’s stuck on, in its own words. It takes ten minutes or less, and it can happen in a conversation rather than a form.
AI helps turn the description into a clear brief: theme, location, the kind of help needed, and the time frame. The original words are always kept.
We suggest research, projects and expertise that could help. Each suggestion comes with a plain-language reason and a note on what we don’t know yet.
A broker with domain experience checks every suggestion before anyone is contacted. Nothing is sent automatically.
Both sides agree to talk. We follow up to see whether the connection worked, and that result is what we measure.

audiences.label: Businesses

audiences.note: We’re starting with NGOs and research.

features: Every challenge carries what’s blocking progress, what would help, where it’s happening and by when. The holder’s original words are always kept.
Every suggestion shows why it might help, what it’s based on and what we don’t know yet. You’ll never see an unexplained percentage score.
A person with domain knowledge reviews each suggestion before an introduction. Search is automated; judgement isn’t.
Every record carries where the work happens, which isn’t always where the organisation is registered. Find others working in the same place, not just on the same theme.
Research records are drafted from open publication data and marked Seeded until the researcher confirms them. Claim, correct or remove your record.
Every record shows whether it’s seeded, claimed, verified or out of date. Needs expire, so the platform doesn’t fill up with stale listings.

does: Turns messy descriptions into clear, structured briefs.
Explains each suggestion in plain language.
never: Make an introduction without a person’s review.

pilot.intro: We’re starting in one region, on one theme, and proving the mechanism works before we grow.
facts: A real challenge. A measured outcome.
phases: Ten conversations with NGOs about real problems.
Set up SCC as a Swiss nonprofit association and secure pilot funding.
One real challenge, with every introduction reviewed by a broker.
Publish what worked, what didn’t, and what comes next.

sdg.title: One starting point. All 17 goals in view.
sdg.body: Need & Know is being designed to be fully aligned with the United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals. Our first pilot focuses on climate adaptation and SDG 13: Climate Action, with a long-term ambition to support collaboration across all 17 goals.

scc.title:
Independent by design.
Connected by purpose.
scc.intro: The Sustainability Collaboration Center exists to help sustainability knowledge turn into action, faster. Need & Know is the first thing we’re building to do that.
scc.body: SCC is being set up as a nonprofit association in Switzerland. Its independence is central to the idea: no shareholders and no commercial interest in who gets matched.
values: We measure conversations started, not listings.
We say what we don’t know.
Of their data, their records and their introductions.
founders: Radhika brings experience connecting research, policy and practice in sustainability, with a focus on nature-based solutions and collaboration between researchers and practitioners.
Nikos is a UX and product leader experienced in designing complex platforms at FNZ, HSBC and Credit Suisse. Based in Vaud, he focuses on making systems trustworthy and usable, with people in control.
